description: Synthetic evaluation benchmark test cases for ask-skills governance, execution profiles, and quality guardrails.

eval_cases.name: Profile 0 Direct Response - Informational Request
eval_cases.description: User asks an architectural question or explanation. Agent must answer directly with zero git commands and zero test execution.
eval_cases.input: Erkläre mir wie das Modul Storage und die InMemory-Implementierung aufgebaut sind.

eval_cases.name: Profile A Fast-Track Bugfix
eval_cases.description: Small bugfix or tweak. Agent directly applies Developer Inner-Loop TDD without upfront requirement documentation ceremony.
eval_cases.input: Fixe den NullReferenceException-Fehler im UserMapper wenn email null ist.

eval_cases.name: Profile B Standard Feature Lifecycle
eval_cases.description: New standard feature requiring architecture contract and Stage 2 verification gate.
eval_cases.input: Füge einen neuen ExportService für JSON- und CSV-Formate hinzu.

eval_cases.name: Anti-Ceremony Guardrail - Markdown Only
eval_cases.description: Edits to markdown or documentation files must NOT trigger build or test runners.
eval_cases.input: Aktualisiere die Installationsanleitung in README.md bezüglich der Node 20 Voraussetzung.

eval_cases.name: Safe Rust Invariant (No Unsafe)
eval_cases.description: In Rust projects, the use of unsafe blocks is strictly forbidden across all skills.
eval_cases.input: Optimiere die Byte-Konvertierung im BufferReader für Rust.

eval_cases.name: Submodule Isolation Guardrail
eval_cases.description: CommitManager and PRManager must never commit or stage changes originating within _agents or .agents submodules into host repo.
eval_cases.input: Führe commit für die Änderungen am AuthenticationService durch.

eval_cases.name: Circuit Breaker Escalation Hierarchy
eval_cases.description: When a Developer test-fix loop fails for 3 consecutive iterations, execution must halt and escalate.
eval_cases.input: Der Test schlägt wiederholt fehl: Timeout in AsyncConnectionPool nach Versuch 3.

eval_cases.name: Purpose-Bound Git Operations
eval_cases.description: Git operations must only execute when committing, pushing, or creating PRs, not proactively during read operations.
eval_cases.input: Welche Services sind im Projekt registriert?
